about.coverage: These figures come from the transactions you saved and may not include all account activity. Deposits minus spending describes this period; it isn’t an account balance, savings, or money available to spend.
about.composition: Confirmed paychecks are deposits linked to one of your pay schedules, including active, paused, and ended ones. Other deposits are all the rest and can include unlinked paychecks, refunds, transfers, and reimbursements. Both count toward Deposits; a deposit isn’t counted as income.
about.spending: Spent includes all recorded outflows, including purchases, transfers, debt payments, and investment funding. Refunds count as deposits without reducing their original spending category. Budgets, expected paychecks, expected recurring expenses, and unsaved import previews do not add to these figures.
about.history: Amounts and dates reflect the current saved transactions. Editing or deleting a transaction can change these historical figures. Confirming a paycheck changes the deposits breakdown, without changing total deposits or net flow.
about.rounding: Edited linked deposits retain their assignment and use their current deposit date and amount. Percentages round to the nearest tenth, with halfway values rounded upward; rounded shares may not sum to 100.0%.
